In a rare move, NHK reports about a "Get rid of racism" rally held today in Shibuya, Tokyo.

Looks like Abe's mouthpiece broadcaster wants to make up for a blunder its program "The World Now @nhk_sekaima" made over #BLM

Abe's mouthpiece:
"Those who chant '#BlackLivesMattters' should realize they are wrong about what racism is. Racism means despising a whole racial group of ppl, but some black ppl are not discriminated against. So using #BLM is wrong and rude to those who are not jim-crowed."
